since_rule: A row carrying `since: <build>` was first observed on that build. hostcheck/probe treat such a row as EXPECTED wherever probing finds it, and as OLDER-BUILD (a pass with a note) where probing finds it absent AND every other fact tagged with the same `since` build is absent too — the build then behaves, as a whole, like one that predates the tag. A mixed group (some since-X facts present, others absent), a missing row without `since`, or an observed gate that is not listed here is FAIL (drift). The version string is quoted in the note only, never used to decide (ARCHITECTURE R15).

accepted_values.note: Measured for EXTERNAL_AGENT_INGRESS (accepts 1|on|true) and SDK_ENABLED (0/false/yes/"" all disable). Treat as INFERRED for the other 39.

probe.note: Only a plugin *mutation* subcommand (enable/disable/install, mode=plugin_mutation) emits all 41 gate.resolve lines; `muse plugins list` does not (canary-diff §1). Gate resolution order in the trace matches the binary order below. The trace writer is LOSSY under concurrent host bootstraps (measured 2026-09-02 on 1.0.1-R2006.1: 8 parallel `plugins enable` + 6 echo sessions in separate HOME/XDG sandboxes gave logs of 0, 14, 22 and 48 lines instead of 49 — a prefix, a suffix, or nothing). A complete log is 8 fixed lines plus one per gate — 49 lines on a 41-gate build (1.0.1-R2006.1, canary), 50 on 1.0.3-R2198.1: event="startup" host="cli" (line 1), process.identity, 4× path.resolved, feature_config.cache, N× gate.resolve, event="trust.resolve" (last line). omm treats a log as authoritative only when BOTH the startup head and the trust.resolve tail are present, and retries the verb otherwise (probe::gates).

mapping_evidence: Two adjacent rodata literals list the env names and the gate ids in identical order (cli-surface §4.1, strings line 177520). config-paths §8.3 originally listed 39 ids (missing voice_default_on and server_web_fetch, and misspelling tui_msp_client as tui_msp_clients); its verification C3 corrected it to 41. DISCREPANCY recorded; 41 taken.
remote_override: Both builds carry a feature_config provider whose override key list includes the gates plus extensions.skills.allowed_digests / extensions.skills.allowed_kinds / extensions.hooks / extensions.runtime_capabilities and settings.run.{system_prompt,developer_prompt,toolset}. Two gates also have literal remote keys: ARTIFACT_TOOL_ENABLED, LOCAL_SESSION_MESSAGING_ENABLED. TBH_DISABLE_FEATURE_CONFIG kills the fetch; omm sets it in the clean environment of every probe (never for `omm run`), and the trace still writes `event="feature_config.cache" state="missing" gate_count=0` (identical 49-line trace with and without the variable, measured 2026-09-02) — hostcheck `gates/feature-config-cache` asserts that line so a populated cache is reported instead of silently moving the gate and bundled rows. The cache lives under the data root (`path.resolved kind="feature_config_cache" source="data_root"`). Never observed populated offline (gate_count=0).
